note: Meridian Regulation's printed category, one reviewed row per printed ability: "Choose one poison, disease, or directly caused physical impairment affecting the target" (Qi Cultivation, CL2; printed text in authority/typed_mechanics/rules_text.json under tianxia.path.qi_cultivation.feature.meridian_regulation). The category belongs to the ABILITY, not to the penalty it happens to leave, so it is recorded here per source ability with the printed sentence that establishes it (quoted word for word out of rules_text.json, so a row can be checked against the rules it encodes). combat/ext/qi_path.py reads this file and offers only an effect whose source ability is listed under "sources". "left_to_the_gm" is the other half of the review: abilities that were read and deliberately NOT placed in the printed three -- a dream, an illusion, a sound, a command, a charm, a fear, a mark, a sensory effect -- each with the printed sentence that was read and why it stays the GM's. Every ability in the typed authority that can leave an effect which repeats a saving throw (the branch that needs only a remembered DC) is in one of the two lists, so an ability cannot fall out of the reviewed set silently; tests/test_auto2_paths_b.py holds the file to that. An ability in neither list is one the table has not read yet, and is the GM's to rule on. To review an ability, add it to "sources" (with its category and the printed sentence) or to "left_to_the_gm" (with the printed sentence and the reason) -- do not classify anything in code.

categories.poison: A poison: the printed effect leaves the target Poisoned, or the printed sentence names the toxin, venom or poison the ability puts into the target.
categories.disease: A disease: the printed sentence names the disease, infection, plague or sickness the ability gives the target.
categories.physical_impairment: A directly caused physical impairment: the printed sentence shows the ability harming or impeding the target's body -- its Speed, its breath, its limbs, its blood, its grip on its weapons, or its own Reactions.
